description: 8 analog input module, Modbus RTU: 10-bit input values, sync values, watchdog and serial settings
source: CTM Electrónica, IA-8 Manual del usuario (V3.5), V3.5
notes: Inputs are digitised with 10 bits; the engineering value depends on the sensor wired to each input.
Functions 1/2 (coils) and 3/4 (registers) are accepted, 0xxxx mirrors 1xxxx and 3xxxx mirrors 4xxxx; functions 5, 6, 15, 16 and 8 (diagnostics) also work.
Register numbers are those of the manual (40001 is the first holding register), counted from 1 (address_base 1).
Serial settings are configurable; the baudrate shown is the factory default. Modbus RTU speeds 1200 to 115200 bps.
Written from the manufacturer's manual (in Spanish); not tested on a device.

registers.name: Watchdog alarm enable
registers.description: 1 enables the watchdog alarm

registers.name: Watchdog alarm event
